answer: Morning after morning the shuttle maker steeps the cloth in the woad vat for a full day, leaving the cloth to soak till the dye bites. Distaff silk warp maker wool licence covers the steeping: a licence silk warp makers carry after warping mill reviews. The forge works the vat, the onyx works the steeping, the vine works the cloth. A counterfeiter must do 71 false vats and 71 false steepings.
